Stale values are served because `Repository::flexible()` takes a `[fresh, total]` TTL pair. Once the entry is older than the fresh period but still in the store, it returns the old value immediately and runs the rebuild as a deferred callback, guarded by a cache lock and a `created` timestamp check so only one refresh writes.
